summary.text: Eligibility is checked yearly. Eligible members get matching grants for cash top-ups made by 31 December.

details.heading: Eligibility and notification
details.body: CPF checks your eligibility every year. If you are eligible, CPF will notify you at the beginning of the year. You can also check your eligibility through the Healthcare dashboard.

details.heading: Cash top-ups
details.body: Cash top-ups to your MediSave Account can come from you, loved ones, employers or community members.

details.heading: When the grant comes
details.body: If you are eligible and receive cash top-ups by 31 December, you get a matching grant at the beginning of the following year.

details.heading: Start date
details.body: The scheme starts in January 2026. Top-ups made before 2026 do not qualify for this matching grant.

sources.page_title: How does the Matched MediSave Scheme work?

quotes.text: Members’ eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme (MMSS) will be automatically assessed annually. No application by members is needed.
Each year, if you are eligible, we will notify you at the beginning of the year. You can also check your eligibility via the Healthcare dashboard.
Cash top-ups to MA can be made by yourself, loved ones, employers or members of the community.
If you are eligible and have received cash top-ups to your MediSave Account (MA) by 31 December of the year, you will receive a matching grant at the beginning of the following year.
MMSS is implemented from January 2026. Cash top-ups made before 2026 is not eligible for matching grants under this scheme.
